values.meaning: bonus physical damage on empowered attack
values.binNote: Wiki states bonus damage of 100% AD + 25% AP. PowerFist#TotalDamage in the bin computes 2xad + 0.25xap (i.e. the ap coefficient of 0.25 matches, but the ad term is 2.0, not 1.0 - likely the bin's total including the base attack's own AD, whereas the wiki figure is only the 'bonus' on top of the normal attack). A second unused calc {a9d6b924} = 1.75xad + 1.25xap does not match either. Reporting the wiki's 1.0/0.25 numbers as stated, flagging the ad discrepancy.

values.meaning: duration the empowered attack buff lasts before expiring
values.quote: empowers their next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds
values.binNote: No data value in the PowerFist bin section corresponds to this 5 second buff-expiry window; only CCDuration (knockup) and the damage calcs are present, so this duration is wiki-text only.

mechanics.claim: Power Fist empowers the next basic attack within 5 seconds, giving it an uncancellable windup, doubling total damage via bonus physical damage, and knocking up the target.
mechanics.quote: '''Blitzcrank''' empowers their next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|100% AD}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} the target for 1 second

mechanics.claim: This bonus damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Power Fist deals basic damage but is also tagged as spell damage, triggering spell effects, including from the basic attack itself.
mechanics.quote: ''Power Fist'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Power Fist resets Blitzcrank's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Power Fist {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Blitzcrank's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts only after the empowered attack resolves.
Spell shield prevents both the knockup and all the damage, including the basic attack's own damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents the {{tip|airborne|knockup}} and the damage, including the damage of the basic attack itself.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack still lands even if the target becomes untargetable during the windup.
mechanics.quote: The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become {{tip|untargetable}} during the {{tip|attack windup|attack's windup}}.

mechanics.claim: Against structures the knockup does not trigger but the Power Fist buff is not consumed, letting the bonus damage be reapplied repeatedly.
mechanics.quote: The ''Power Fist'' buff does not get consumed if the knockup doesn't trigger, allowing '''Blitzcrank''' to repeatedly attack structures for bonus damage.
